nodes.label: Army-points
nodes.rationale: A descriptive capability yardstick decks are built under, not a win-rate prediction; measured balance always overrules it (ADR-0002). Computed additively from a card's steps, never stored per card.

nodes.label: Points cap (deck budget)
nodes.rationale: A shared army-points budget lets two asymmetric decks be 'matched' in capability so an asymmetric skirmish stays fair.

nodes.label: Tolerance temperature (strict/explore/hot)
nodes.rationale: How far a measured metric may sit outside its band before a result is accepted (a verdict on outputs). Distinct from exploration temperature.

nodes.label: Exploration temperature
nodes.rationale: How large a step content iteration takes through design space, realized chiefly through the points cap. An input to the search; distinct from tolerance temperature.

nodes.label: Mispricing residual
nodes.rationale: Gap between a card's measured win-contribution and its army-points cost; the anti-slop signal. Advisory only because of the Timing blind spot.

nodes.label: Timing blind spot
nodes.rationale: The balance scorer cannot value a card whose worth is in WHEN it is held/played; such a card can read mispriced without being so.

nodes.label: AI personality
nodes.rationale: A named heuristic weight-set giving the bot a character/playstyle rather than maximal strength. Distinct from a Commander trait.

nodes.label: Commander trait
nodes.rationale: A run-layer ability that bends the rules for a side; belongs to the not-yet-in-code Campaign layer. A rule-bender, not a playstyle.
